find.match_belief: Growing up in LA i was always curious, but it wasn’t until I was removed from it at college that I realized it was a passion that ran deep. My favorite thing is working with people, especially people who create cool art. What better job than one that combines both?

profile.belief: Music has been a part of my life since I was 4 but only as a hobby. Being able to do it as a career has been a dream. Waking up to never hate my job is probably the only thing I can ask for. Music is something everyone listens to no matter what, being able to be at the forefront of that is definitely what drew me to it.
profile.working_on: My goal that I am working up to right now is being an A&R exec at Indie major label. But the ultimate goal is to start my own record label that is very artist forward that doesn't make artists feel like they are heard and they have a team to support them to get their creative vision across.
